responsibility: Implements small utility routines used by diagnostics classes to provide human-readable debug dumps of their internal state. It centralizes indentation, headings, typed field emitters, and '(none)' output so buffers, sinks, file caches, and option bundles can expose consistent dump(FILE*, indent) output without each class reimplementing formatting boilerplate.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation file for the dumping pair: it provides the concrete emit_indent, emit_heading, field-emitter, and emit_none routines used by diagnostics classes when dumping state. In contrast, dumping.h only declares those helper functions and macros.
